reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, enlarged existing source-page 14 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA and native note/right-edge crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and evidence, and unchanged naiwa.png; checked bald crown and remaining side hair, round glasses, clean-shaven face, mild smile, suit/tie, collar, backplate, note footprint and right-edge tab.

remaining_reasons: The returned native note adds TWO small gray dash marks below the left side of the second main upper row, outside the original compact upper marking footprint. The enlarged original has no such independent lower dashes. Remove both added marks and restore only the source's existing faint groups and blank areas; do not treat unrelated faint paper texture as part of this rejection.

The original small dark right-edge note tab is replaced by a triangular brown paper fold/notch in the native return. Restore the source's compact dark tab in its original position and form rather than substituting a crease or torn notch.
entries.positive_observation: The bald crown and high bare forehead retain short dark-brown hair at the sides/back and short sideburns. Dark brows and round dark-rimmed glasses remain, with a clean-shaven smooth chin, no moustache or beard and one mild closed-mouth smile. The nearly frontal slight-left pose, tight crop and soft frontal light remain. The dark charcoal suit, white pointed shirt collar and dark tie remain without decorations. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or pinching. The dark blue-gray photographic backplate and thin dark frame remain opaque. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte ring; the two added lower dashes and right-edge tab substitution remain separate visible rejection reasons.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine glasses-rim detail, note glyphs and tie pattern are too small to read at 65x67 and are not rejection grounds. The rejection relies on the clearly resolved two extra lower dashes and changed right-edge structure in native/enlarged comparisons, not on interpreting writing, ordinary paper texture or alpha numbers.
